Copilot left **one review** on PR #38, with **no inline comments** but one suppressed low-confidence note worth addressing:

**Concern (ContactManagerApp.swift:132):** In `CONTACTMANAGER_UI_TEST_MODE` the app still builds a CloudKit-backed container (`cloudKitDatabase: .automatic`). Combined with the forced seeding, a developer running UI tests while signed into iCloud could push the sample contacts to their CloudKit DB and sync them across devices. Copilot suggests forcing a local-only configuration (CloudKit disabled) in UI-test mode.

That's a legitimate point — the seed-on-launch behavior makes the CloudKit risk real. Want me to fix it (force `cloudKitDatabase: .none` when `CONTACTMANAGER_UI_TEST_MODE` is set)?

96	    // MARK: - Container loading
97	
98	    private static func loadContainer(resettingStore: Bool = false) -> ContainerLoadState {
99	        // UI test mode is detected via env var and pre-empts the unit-test
100	        // guard below: XCUITest injects an automation-support library
101	        // that drags `XCTestCase` into the app's loaded classes, so the
102	        // `NSClassFromString` check would short-circuit to `.testing` and
103	        // render `EmptyView()`. The flag itself just forces a fresh disk
104	        // store; the rest of the load path is identical to production so
105	        // UI tests exercise the same code real users run.
106	        let isUITestMode = ProcessInfo.processInfo
107	            .environment["CONTACTMANAGER_UI_TEST_MODE"] != nil
108	
109	        if !isUITestMode {
110	            // When hosting the unit tests, skip building the app's model
111	            // container entirely so the test target owns the only
112	            // container in the process.
113	            let isUnitTesting = ProcessInfo.processInfo
114	                .environment["XCTestConfigurationFilePath"] != nil
115	                || NSClassFromString("XCTestCase") != nil
116	            if isUnitTesting { return .testing }
117	        }
118	
119	        if resettingStore || isUITestMode {
120	            deleteDefaultStore()
121	        }
122	
123	        let schema = Schema([Contact.self, ContactField.self, ContactGroup.self])
124	
125	        // Build a CloudKit-backed container when the iCloud capability is
126	        // present, and fall back to a local-only container otherwise so the
127	        // app still runs without iCloud.
128	        let container: ModelContainer
129	        var isLocalOnlyFallback = false
130	        do {
131	            // `.automatic` uses the project's iCloud container when an iCloud
132	            // entitlement is present; without one it still loads successfully
133	            // and behaves as a local-only store.
134	            let cloudConfiguration = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, cloudKitDatabase: .automatic)
135	            container = try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: cloudConfiguration)
136	        } catch {
137	            print("ContactManager: CloudKit container failed (\(error.localizedDescription)); using local.")
138	            do {
139	                let localConfiguration = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, cloudKitDatabase: .none)
140	                container = try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: localConfiguration)
141	                isLocalOnlyFallback = true
142	            } catch {
143	                return .failed(error.localizedDescription)
144	            }
145	        }
146	
147	        // Only seed sample data on the confirmed local-only fallback. On a
148	        // CloudKit-capable container the user's real contacts might be about
149	        // to sync down (a fresh install on a second device); seeding then
150	        // would race the sync and propagate the samples to every device.
151	        // UI-test mode always seeds: the store was wiped above and the tests
152	        // depend on the standard three sample contacts being present.
153	        if isLocalOnlyFallback || isUITestMode {
154	            do {
155	                try SampleData.seedIfNeeded(container.mainContext)
156	            } catch {
157	                print("ContactManager: sample data seeding skipped — \(error)")
158	            }
159	        }
160	        // Publish the container for App Intents (Shortcuts/Spotlight queries)
161	        // and kick off an initial Spotlight reindex.
162	        EntityModelContainer.shared = container
163	        Task.detached { await SpotlightIndexer.shared.reindex() }
164	        return .ready(container)
165	    }
166	
167	    /// Removes the default SwiftData store files so a corrupt store can be
168	    /// recovered from without reinstalling the app.
169	    private static func deleteDefaultStore() {
170	        let fileManager = FileManager.default
171	        guard let support = try? fileManager.url(
172	            for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask,
173	            appropriateFor: nil, create: false
174	        ) else { return }
175	
176	        for suffix in ["", "-wal", "-shm"] {
177	            try? fileManager.removeItem(at: support.appending(path: "default.store\(suffix)"))
178	        }
179	    }
180	}
181

183	    case ready(ModelContainer)
184	    case testing
185	    case failed(String)
186	}

197	        } description: {

199	        } actions: {

201	                .buttonStyle(.glassProminent)
202	        }
203	        .frame(minWidth: 360, minHeight: 240)

205	}

10	The ContactManager app (an old ObjC/AppKit + Core Data + XIB demo) is being rebuilt into a **native macOS Tahoe (macOS 26) app**. Decisions confirmed by the user on 2026-05-25:
11	
12	- **Full SwiftUI rewrite** (NavigationSplitView: sidebar / list / detail, Liquid Glass).
13	- **SwiftData** as the persistence layer (replacing Core Data).
14	- Wants **all four feature areas**: search & alphabetical sections, contact photos (initials fallback), richer fields (multiple emails/phones, company/title, address, birthday, notes), groups/tags + vCard import/export.
15	
16	**Why:** User wants the app to keep evolving toward a polished native Tahoe contact manager; it doubles as a best-practices demo.
17	
18	**How to apply:** Ship as focused, single-purpose PRs (matching the existing PR #1–#8 workflow), each building cleanly. Roadmap + status:
19	- PR A — Foundation ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #9. SwiftUI+SwiftData shell, CRUD, seed data, macOS 26, ObjC/XIB removed, Swift Testing.
20	- PR B — Richer fields ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #11 (originally #10; see lesson below). ContactField child entity (labeled emails/phones), company/title/address/birthday/notes, grouped Form editor.
21	- PR C — Search & sections ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #12. Live search, alphabetical sections + "#", Last/First name sort toggle (@AppStorage).
22	- PR D — Contact photos ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #13. External-storage photoData, photo well in detail, ImageProcessing downscaling, off-main processing.
23	- PR E — Groups & vCard ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #14. ContactGroup many-to-many, sidebar group CRUD, detail membership toggles, pure vCard 3.0 reader/writer + File import/export.
24	- PR F — Tahoe Liquid Glass polish ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #15. Glass-prominent action buttons, list/selection/avatar animations, min window size.
25	
26	Tooling/conventions: PR #16 (`chore/lint-format-and-conventions`) adds SwiftLint + SwiftFormat (configs `.swiftlint.yml`/`.swiftformat`), a Makefile, a SwiftLint build phase, and a root `CLAUDE.md`. Run `make check` (format-check + lint + test) before opening PRs; conventions live in CLAUDE.md (loaded each session). SwiftFormat owns comma/brace style; SwiftLint's trailing_comma is disabled and wrapMultilineStatementBraces is disabled to keep the two consistent + idempotent.
27	
28	ROADMAP COMPLETE as of 2026-05-26: all six PRs (#9, #11, #12, #13, #14, #15) merged to main. App is a native SwiftUI + SwiftData macOS 26 contact manager; 21 Swift Testing tests across 3 suites green on main. Future work would be net-new (e.g., CloudKit sync, contact dedup, vCard PHOTO round-trip, AppKit→SwiftUI inspector).
29	
30	Liquid Glass note (macOS 26.5 SDK): `.glassEffect()` modifier and `GlassEffectContainer` are NOT in the SwiftUI swiftinterface, but `.buttonStyle(.glass)` / `.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)` (GlassButtonStyle/GlassProminentButtonStyle) and `.backgroundExtensionEffect()` ARE. Toolbars + NavigationSplitView adopt Liquid Glass automatically when built against the SDK.
31	
32	As of 2026-05-25, #9 and #11 are MERGED into main; 9 Swift tests green on main.
33	
34	Copilot review fixes already applied (don't regress): error-state container load with "Reset Data" (no fatalError), save-error alerts + rollback in ContentView, throwing SampleData.seedIfNeeded, deterministic avatar color from createdAt (not hashValue/abs), ContactField sortIndex = max+1.
35	
36	Key learnings:
37	- Toolchain: Xcode 26.5, macOS 26.5 SDK, Swift 6.3 (SWIFT_VERSION 5.0 in project). Project `.pbxproj` restructured via the Ruby `xcodeproj` gem (available), not hand-edited. App icon from PR #7 preserved.
38	- SwiftData tests: use `@Suite(.serialized)` + `@MainActor`, hold the `ModelContainer` as a stored property, and have the host app skip building its own container while testing (`XCTestConfigurationFilePath` env) — concurrent/duplicate containers for the same `@Model` trap SwiftData.
39	- SwiftData migration: new non-optional scalar attributes MUST have inline defaults (e.g. `var city: String = ""`) or in-place migration fails with NSCocoaError 134110.
40	- No display access in this environment — cannot screencapture the running app; verify via build + tests + headless launch (process stays alive).
41	- `gh pr merge --delete-branch` deletes the LOCAL branch too, and deleting a base branch of a stacked PR CLOSES the dependent PR (GitHub won't retarget, and a closed PR whose base is gone can't be reopened/retargeted). For stacked PRs: merge the base PR, then retarget the child PR to main BEFORE deleting the base branch — or just recreate the child PR from its branch (that's what happened: #10 closed → recreated as #11).

# ContactManager — Pre-ship Punch List

A 100% SwiftUI/SwiftData app with admirably tight architecture (pure helpers, `ContactStore` mutate-with-undo, CloudKit-ready schema, App Intents + Spotlight, in-memory test container). The gaps below are what a senior Apple engineer would still want fixed before calling it "done" on macOS 26.

## P0 — must-fix before shipping

- **App Sandbox is disabled.** `project.pbxproj` has `ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME=YES` but no `ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=YES`, no `.entitlements` file, and `CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS` is unset. The app cannot ship on the Mac App Store and won't notarize cleanly. **Fix:** add `ContactManager.entitlements` with `com.apple.security.app-sandbox`, `files.user-selected.read-write` (for `.fileImporter`/`.fileExporter` and drop-import), and (if iCloud is intended) `com.apple.developer.icloud-container-identifiers` + CloudKit service. Evidence: `ContactManager.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:618,656` (hardened-runtime only).

- **No CloudKit entitlement actually wired.** `ContactManagerApp.swift:141` builds with `cloudKitDatabase: .automatic` but the pbxproj has no `com.apple.developer.icloud-container-identifiers` / `ubiquity-kvstore-identifier`. On a real build the "automatic" path silently degrades to local; the README promises iCloud sync. **Fix:** add the iCloud capability and an entitlements file, or change the README + code comment to say "local-only ship, iCloud parked."

- **`@AppStorage("contactSortOrder")` stores an enum directly.** `ContentView.swift:29`, `SettingsView.swift:14` — `ContactSortOrder` is `String`-rawValue but isn't `RawRepresentable` to `AppStorage` without a manual init; this currently compiles only because of the implicit `RawRepresentable` AppStorage overload available since iOS 17 — verify on a fresh launch with no defaults written. **Fix:** explicit unit test that the default round-trips after a relaunch, or persist `rawValue: String` and map.

- **Unbounded reads on every search keystroke.** `ContactQuery.filtered` (`ContactQuery.swift:49-63`) walks every contact and every field on every keystroke; `searchable` does not debounce. With 10k contacts and a few emails each this will visibly hitch. **Fix:** debounce `searchText` via `.task(id: searchText)` + `try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(150))`, and prefilter by name with a SwiftData `#Predicate` `FetchDescriptor` before the in-memory pass.

- **Spotlight reindex is full-snapshot on every save.** `SpotlightIndexer.reindex()` (`SpotlightIndexer.swift:28-46`) deletes the entire domain and re-adds all contacts on every `contactsDidChange`. At 10k contacts this becomes O(n) CPU per single-field edit. **Fix:** index incrementally — pass the changed contact's id into the notification and call `indexSearchableItems([item])` / `deleteSearchableItems(withIdentifiers:)`. Keep the full reindex as a launch-time path only.

## P1 — should-fix before 1.0

- **No `tel:` / `mailto:` integration.** `ContactDetailView.quickRow` (`ContactDetailView.swift:160-185`) only offers Copy. The macOS-native expectation is a click-to-call/mail action. **Fix:** wrap the value in a `Link` or `Button` calling `NSWorkspace.shared.open(URL(string: "mailto:\(value)")!)`, gated by `force_unwrapping` lint.

- **No ShareLink / Services menu integration.** Nowhere in `Views/` is `ShareLink` or `NSSharingServicePicker` used. **Fix:** add `ShareLink(item: VCardTransfer(...))` to the detail toolbar — reuses the existing `Transferable` and is one line.

- **No keyboard shortcut to focus search.** `searchable` on `ContactListView` (`ContactListView.swift:46`) has no companion `.keyboardShortcut`/`searchFocused`. Cmd-F is the convention. **Fix:** add `@FocusState` with `.searchable(...).searchFocused($searchFocused)` and a `CommandGroup(after: .textEditing)` button bound to ⌘F.

- **No default focus on detail form.** Pressing ⌘N opens a new contact and the user has to mouse to "First Name". **Fix:** `@FocusState` on the first text field, `.defaultFocus($focus, .firstName)` keyed on `contact.persistentModelID`.

- **Birthday assumes `Calendar.current.gregorian`.** `ContactsBridge.swift:85` hardcodes `Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)`; `VCard.swift:55` uses `.autoupdatingCurrent` timezone for a wall-clock date. A user in Tokyo importing a US-exported vCard will routinely see the day shift. **Fix:** store the birthday as `DateComponents` (year/month/day) in a new attribute, migrate the legacy `Date`. Or at minimum lock VCard's serializer/deserializer to UTC noon to make round-trips stable.

- **Photo file read isn't size-limited.** `ContactDetailView.swift:259` does `Data(contentsOf: url)` for any picked file before downscaling. Dropping a 300 MB raw image will allocate 300 MB. **Fix:** prefer `ImageProcessing.avatarData(from: url)` (`ImageProcessing.swift:22-25`) — it already exists and uses `CGImageSourceCreateWithURL` so the full file never enters memory.

- **vCard 4.0 not advertised on write.** `VCard.swift:67` always emits `VERSION:3.0`. The Apple Contacts.app on macOS 26 reads 4.0 by default. Round-tripping works, but tagging it 3.0 forfeits the cleaner photo data-URI we already accept on read (`VCard.swift:226`). **Fix:** keep 3.0 (compat-wide) or move to 4.0 + `PHOTO:data:image/jpeg;base64,...` — pick one, document why.

- **System Contacts import fetches everything synchronously into RAM.** `ContactsBridge.swift:46-56` builds an unbounded `[ParsedContact]` array, then `ContactStore.importContacts` (`ContactStore.swift:209-215`) inserts them all in a single undo group and one save. With a 20k-row Address Book this blocks the main actor for seconds (insert is `@MainActor`) and produces a giant single-undo step. **Fix:** chunk the insert (e.g. 500 contacts/save) and show a progress sheet.

- **No progress UI for long imports.** All three import paths (`ContentView+Import.swift:24-155`) show nothing while parsing/inserting. A 5 MB vCard freezes the UI silently. **Fix:** a sheet with a determinate `ProgressView` or an indeterminate `ContentUnavailableView` overlay.

- **vCard 4.0 BDAY `--MM-DD` (no year) is dropped silently.** `VCard.swift:197` slices `prefix(10)` then runs the `yyyy-MM-dd` formatter; `--12-25` fails. **Fix:** add a fallback `MM-dd` formatter; persist as nil-year `DateComponents` (see birthday note above).

- **Group reorder + drag-into-group are missing.** `SidebarView.swift:37-52` is a flat List with no drop destination for `Contact` — yet the row exposes `.draggable`. Dragging from list to sidebar group does nothing. **Fix:** `.dropDestination(for: ContactTransfer.self)` on the group row; route through `store.setMembership`.

- **No Print / Export PDF.** macOS users expect File ▸ Print of a contact card or list. Nothing implements it. **Fix:** `PrintableContact` `View` + `NSPrintOperation` from a menu command.

- **No accessibility label on `.badge(count)` rows.** `SidebarView.swift:33` and `:44` — VoiceOver reads "All Contacts, 3" but doesn't say "contacts." `.accessibilityValue(Text("^[\(count) contact](inflect: true)"))` would. **Fix:** add inflected `.accessibilityValue` and `.accessibilityLabel` overrides on the rows with badges.

## P2 — polish & follow-ups

- **No localization.** Every UI string in Views/ is a Swift string literal; no `.xcstrings`, no `String(localized:)`, no `LocalizationCatalog` resource. `Localizable.xcstrings` should be generated and at least the menu strings extracted. Most LocalizedStringResource use in App Intents (`FindContactIntent.swift:13`) is the only correct example.

- **`abs`-style trap on `Int.min` is correctly avoided in `AvatarView.swift:55`** — good — but `Contact.colorSeed` (`Contact.swift:118`) truncates a Double's bit pattern, so the seed isn't actually stable across the migration of `createdAt` if its sub-ms component changes (not currently possible, but document the assumption).

- **`ContactStore` mutation may fire `contactsDidChange` after a partial undo group.** `ContactStore.swift:262-263` posts inside `mutate` after `save()` — fine, but the catch branch calls `context.rollback()` then `endUndoGrouping()` *without* `setActionName`. SwiftUI may then merge this empty group with the next mutation. **Fix:** explicitly `removeAllActions(withTarget:)` or wrap the failure case in `disableUndoRegistration()`.

- **Detail view loses scroll position on selection swap.** `ContentView.swift:106-107` uses `.id(selectedContact.persistentModelID)` which forces full re-creation — intended for state isolation but kills any in-progress edit animation. Acceptable; just note it.

- **`ContactWindowView` does not auto-close when its contact is deleted.** `ContactWindowView.swift:35-49` shows a "Contact Not Found" placeholder forever. **Fix:** observe `.contactsDidChange` and call `dismissWindow(id: "contact", value: encodedID)` when the contact disappears.

- **No Handoff `NSUserActivity` advertising the open contact.** Only inbound `onContinueUserActivity` from Spotlight is wired (`ContentView.swift:156`). Continuity-style "pick up on another device" is missing — `Contact` already has a stable encoded id. **Fix:** add `.userActivity("com.scottdensmore.ContactManager.viewContact") { activity in ... }` on the detail.

- **`@AppStorage("defaultGroupID")` stores a JSON-encoded `PersistentIdentifier`.** Works, but if the user re-installs the app onto the same store the PID may decode but point at a different store URI in some SwiftData migration paths. **Fix:** guarded by `pruneStaleDefaultGroup` (`SettingsView.swift:61-71`) — keep, but add a unit test that exercises the stale-group prune (`SettingsViewTests` doesn't exist).

- **`fields` order isn't transactionally safe across undo.** `ContactStore.addField` (`ContactStore.swift:55-63`) computes `nextIndex` from in-memory state; if two add operations race in the same RunLoop tick, both could pick the same index. Unlikely under the current main-actor model, but worth a test.

- **No `MenuBarExtra` or Spotlight-like quick-add window.** Optional but a real "feature gap" vs Contacts.app: ⌃⌥Space-style quick contact add.

- **Test coverage gaps:** `ContentView` import flows (`ContentView+Import.swift`) — no test; `SpotlightIndexer` — no test (would need a stub of `CSSearchableIndex`); `SettingsView.pruneStaleDefaultGroup` — no test; `OpenContactIntent` — no test; window-restoration round-trip via `WindowGroup(for: String.self)` — no test. UI tests are intentionally smoke-only (`ContactManagerUITests.swift:14-22`); add at least one journey test (create → edit → delete) so refactors of the form don't go undetected.

- **README is stale.** `README.md:32-35` doesn't mention `Intents/`, App Intents, Spotlight, drag-and-drop, CSV import, the detached window, or `ContactManagerUITests/`. Update the source-layout block and Features list to reflect the last six PRs.

## Things this audit did NOT find missing

- Threading / actor hygiene: image decode is detached, parse is detached, indexer is an `actor`, intent queries snapshot on a fresh `ModelContext` — all correct.
- SwiftData migration safety: every non-optional attribute has an inline default, all to-many relationships are `= []`, no `@Attribute(.unique)`, no `.deny` rules.
- The duplicate-finder logic (`DuplicateFinder.swift`) and merge semantics (`ContactStore.merge`, `mergeFields`) are solid and well-tested.
- VoiceOver hygiene on rows and quick-info is genuinely thoughtful (`ContactListView.swift:148`, `ContactDetailView.swift:174-184`, `AvatarView.swift:44`) — better than most ship-1.0 macOS apps.

Audit complete. The architecture is in good shape — what's missing is ship-readiness and polish, not core features. Here's the prioritized punch list with file:line evidence.

## P0 — must-fix before shipping

1. **App Sandbox is off.** `ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME=YES` but no `ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX`, no `.entitlements` file. Can't notarize cleanly or hit the Mac App Store. → Add `ContactManager.entitlements` with `app-sandbox` + `files.user-selected.read-write`. (`project.pbxproj:618,656`)

2. **CloudKit promised but not wired.** `ContactManagerApp.swift:141` uses `cloudKitDatabase: .automatic`, but the project has no iCloud capability — silently degrades to local. Either add the capability + container ID, or update the README/comment to "local-only ship."

3. **Search hitches at scale.** `ContactQuery.filtered` walks every contact × every field on every keystroke; no debounce. → Add a 150 ms debounce via `.task(id: searchText)` and prefilter with a SwiftData `#Predicate` before the in-memory pass. (`ContactQuery.swift:49-63`)

4. **Spotlight full reindex on every save.** `SpotlightIndexer.reindex()` deletes + re-adds the entire domain per `contactsDidChange`. O(n) CPU per field edit. → Incremental: pass the changed id and call `indexSearchableItems([item])` / `deleteSearchableItems(withIdentifiers:)`. Keep full reindex for launch only. (`SpotlightIndexer.swift:28-46`)

## P1 — before 1.0

- **`mailto:` / `tel:` actions.** Detail rows only Copy; missing the macOS-native click-to-mail/call. (`ContactDetailView.swift:160-185`)
- **`ShareLink` integration.** `VCardTransfer` (already `Transferable`) drops into a one-line `ShareLink` for the detail toolbar.
- **⌘F to focus search.** `searchable` has no `searchFocused`/keyboard shortcut. (`ContactListView.swift:46`)
- **Default focus on first field for new contact.** ⌘N opens the form, you have to mouse to "First Name."
- **Photo read isn't size-limited.** `Data(contentsOf:)` before downscale — drop a 300 MB raw, allocate 300 MB. `ImageProcessing.avatarData(from:)` already does the safe path; use it. (`ContactDetailView.swift:259`)
- **Birthday timezone bug.** `--MM-DD` (vCard 4.0, no year) is dropped silently; current import uses `.autoupdatingCurrent`, so Tokyo→US round-trips can shift a day. Store as `DateComponents`. (`VCard.swift:55,197`, `ContactsBridge.swift:85`)
- **Sidebar groups have no drop destination.** Rows are `.draggable` from the list, but dragging a contact onto a group does nothing.
- **No import progress UI.** All three import paths show nothing — a 5 MB vCard freezes the UI silently. (`ContentView+Import.swift:24-155`)
- **System Contacts import has no chunking.** Builds an unbounded array on main, single mega-undo step. Chunk ~500 per save with progress. (`ContactsBridge.swift:46-56`, `ContactStore.swift:209-215`)
- **No Print / Export PDF.** macOS users expect File ▸ Print of a card or list.

## P2 — polish & follow-ups

- **No localization.** All UI strings are literal; the only correct `LocalizedStringResource` is in `FindContactIntent.swift:13`. Generate `Localizable.xcstrings`.
- **`ContactWindowView` doesn't close when its contact is deleted** — shows "Contact Not Found" forever. (`ContactWindowView.swift:35-49`)
- **No outbound Handoff `NSUserActivity`** for the open contact (inbound from Spotlight is wired).
- **Test gaps:** `ContentView+Import`, `SpotlightIndexer`, `SettingsView.pruneStaleDefaultGroup`, `OpenContactIntent`, window-restoration round-trip. UI tests are intentionally smoke-only — add one create→edit→delete journey.
- **README is stale** — doesn't mention `Intents/`, App Intents, Spotlight, drag-and-drop, CSV import, detached window, or UI tests.

## What the audit cleared

Threading/actor hygiene, SwiftData migration safety, duplicate-finder logic, and VoiceOver hygiene on rows + avatar are all genuinely solid — better than most shipping 1.0 macOS apps.

{
  "file_path": "/tmp/cm_tally.py",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Tally Bash + MCP tool calls from recent Claude Code transcripts.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport re\nimport shlex\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nTRANSCRIPTS = Path(\"/tmp/cm_recent_transcripts.txt\").read_text().strip().splitlines()\n\nbash_counter: Counter = Counter()\nmcp_counter: Counter = Counter()\n\nENV_VAR_RE = re.compile(r\"^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=\")\n\n\ndef normalize_bash(cmd: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return a (command, first_subcommand) signature for tally purposes.\"\"\"\n    cmd = cmd.strip()\n    if not cmd:\n        return None\n    # Take only the first segment before pipes/&&/||/;\n    for sep in [\"&&\", \"||\", \";\", \"|\"]:\n        idx = cmd.find(sep)\n        if idx != -1:\n            cmd = cmd[:idx].strip()\n    try:\n        tokens = shlex.split(cmd, posix=True)\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n    # Strip leading env var assignments\n    while tokens and ENV_VAR_RE.match(tokens[0]):\n        tokens.pop(0)\n    # Strip leading sudo / timeout / nice / etc.\n    PREFIX_WRAPPERS = {\"sudo\", \"timeout\", \"nice\", \"env\", \"command\"}\n    while tokens and tokens[0] in PREFIX_WRAPPERS:\n        tokens.pop(0)\n        # `env` might have its own VAR=val args\n        while tokens and ENV_VAR_RE.match(tokens[0]):\n            tokens.pop(0)\n    if not tokens:\n        return None\n    head = tokens[0]\n    # Drop absolute path component for binaries like /usr/bin/git\n    if \"/\" in head:\n        head = head.split(\"/\")[-1]\n    # Subcommand: first non-flag token after the head\n    sub = \"\"\n    for t in tokens[1:]:\n        if not t.startswith(\"-\"):\n            sub = t\n            break\n    if sub:\n        return f\"{head} {sub}\"\n    return head\n\n\nfor path in TRANSCRIPTS:\n    p = Path(path)\n    if not p.exists():\n        continue\n    try:\n        with p.open() as f:\n            for line in f:\n                line = line.strip()\n                if not line:\n                    continue\n                try:\n                    obj = json.loads(line)\n                except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                    continue\n                msg = obj.get(\"message\")\n                if not isinstance(msg, dict):\n                    continue\n                if msg.get(\"role\") != \"assistant\":\n                    continue\n                content = msg.get(\"content\")\n                if not isinstance(content, list):\n                    continue\n                for item in content:\n                    if not isinstance(item, dict):\n                        continue\n                    if item.get(\"type\") != \"tool_use\":\n                        continue\n                    name = item.get(\"name\", \"\")\n                    inp = item.get(\"input\", {})\n                    if name == \"Bash\":\n                        cmd = inp.get(\"command\", \"\") if isinstance(inp, dict) else \"\"\n                        sig = normalize_bash(cmd)\n                        if sig:\n                            bash_counter[sig] += 1\n                    elif name.startswith(\"mcp__\"):\n                        mcp_counter[name] += 1\n    except OSError:\n        continue\n\nprint(\"=== BASH (top 50) ===\")\nfor sig, count in bash_counter.most_common(50):\n    print(f\"{count:>4}  {sig}\")\nprint()\nprint(\"=== MCP ===\")\nfor name, count in mcp_counter.most_common():\n    print(f\"{count:>4}  {name}\")\n"
}

```json
{
  "file_path": "/tmp/cm_enable_sandbox.rb",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env ruby\n# Enables App Sandbox on the ContactManager app target and wires up the\n# entitlements file. Idempotent — re-running leaves the project unchanged.\nrequire \"xcodeproj\"\n\nproject_path = File.expand_path(\n  \"../ContactManager.xcodeproj\",\n  File.expand_path(File.dirname(__FILE__))\n)\nproject = Xcodeproj::Project.open(project_path)\n\napp_target = project.native_targets.find { |t| t.name == \"ContactManager\" }\nabort \"ContactManager target not found\" unless app_target\n\nentitlements_relative_path = \"ContactManager/ContactManager.entitlements\"\n\n# Register the file in the project tree (sibling group \"ContactManager\") so it\n# shows up in Xcode's navigator alongside Info.plist-style resources. Add to\n# the project but NOT to any build phase — Xcode picks it up via CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS.\ncontact_manager_group = project.main_group[\"ContactManager\"] ||\n                        project.main_group.find_subpath(\"ContactManager\", true)\nunless contact_manager_group.files.any? { |f| f.path == \"ContactManager.entitlements\" }\n  contact_manager_group.new_file(\"ContactManager.entitlements\")\nend\n\napp_target.build_configurations.each do |config|\n  config.build_settings[\"CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS\"] = entitlements_relative_path\n  config.build_settings[\"ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX\"] = \"YES\"\nend\n\nproject.save\nputs \"Enabled App Sandbox + entitlements on target 'ContactManager'.\"\n"
}
```

1	//
2	//  ContactQuery.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  Pure, testable helpers for filtering, sorting, and sectioning contacts.
6	//  Keeping this logic out of the views makes it straightforward to unit test.
7	//
8	
9	import Foundation
10	
11	/// The order contacts are sorted and grouped by.
12	enum ContactSortOrder: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
13	    case lastName
14	    case firstName
15	
16	    var id: String { rawValue }
17	
18	    var title: String {
19	        switch self {
20	        case .lastName: "Last Name"
21	        case .firstName: "First Name"
22	        }
23	    }
24	}
25	
26	/// An alphabetical group of contacts, titled by initial ("A"…"Z" or "#").
27	struct ContactSection: Identifiable {
28	    let title: String
29	    let contacts: [Contact]
30	    var id: String { title }
31	}
32	
33	enum ContactQuery {
34	    /// Sorts contacts by the given order's primary key, then its secondary key.
35	    static func sorted(_ contacts: [Contact], by order: ContactSortOrder = .lastName) -> [Contact] {
36	        contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in
37	            let lhsKeys = lhs.sortKeys(for: order)
38	            let rhsKeys = rhs.sortKeys(for: order)
39	            if lhsKeys.primary != rhsKeys.primary {
40	                return lhsKeys.primary < rhsKeys.primary
41	            }
42	            return lhsKeys.secondary < rhsKeys.secondary
43	        }
44	    }
45	
46	    /// Filters contacts whose name, company, job title, notes, or any email/
47	    /// phone field value contains the query. An empty query returns every
48	    /// contact unchanged.
49	    static func filtered(_ contacts: [Contact], matching query: String) -> [Contact] {
50	        let needle = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
51	        guard !needle.isEmpty else { return contacts }
52	
53	        return contacts.filter { contact in
54	            let haystacks = [
55	                contact.fullName,
56	                contact.company,
57	                contact.jobTitle,
58	                contact.notes,
59	            ] + contact.fields.map(\.value)
60	
61	            return haystacks.contains { $0.lowercased().contains(needle) }
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    /// Groups contacts into alphabetical sections by their initial, sorted
66	    /// within each section. Names that don't start with a letter land in a
67	    /// trailing "#" section.
68	    static func sections(_ contacts: [Contact], by order: ContactSortOrder = .lastName) -> [ContactSection] {
69	        let ordered = sorted(contacts, by: order)
70	        let grouped = Dictionary(grouping: ordered) { sectionTitle(for: $0, order: order) }
71	
72	        let titles = grouped.keys.sorted { lhs, rhs in
73	            if lhs == "#" { return false } // "#" always sorts last
74	            if rhs == "#" { return true }
75	            return lhs < rhs
76	        }
77	
78	        return titles.map { ContactSection(title: $0, contacts: grouped[$0] ?? []) }
79	    }
80	
81	    private static func sectionTitle(for contact: Contact, order: ContactSortOrder) -> String {
82	        guard let first = contact.sortKeys(for: order).primary.first, first.isLetter else {
83	            return "#"
84	        }
85	        return String(first).uppercased()
86	    }
87	}
88

> AGENT

Two changes I'll make:
1. **Optimize `ContactQuery.filtered`** — use `localizedCaseInsensitiveContains` (no per-string `.lowercased()` allocation) and short-circuit on scalar fields before walking the relationship.
2. **Debounce searchText** — 150ms via `.task(id:)`, with a fast-path for empty so clearing the search clears immediately.

Punting the SwiftData `#Predicate`/`FetchDescriptor` rewrite — that's a bigger structural change (child view with `@Query`, group-scope predicate) and the debounce already eliminates the per-keystroke hitch.

An empty query returns every\n    /// contact unchanged.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `localizedCaseInsensitiveContains` (no per-string `.lowercased()`\n    /// allocation) and short-circuits on the cheap scalar attributes before\n    /// walking the to-many `fields` relationship.\n    static func filtered(_ contacts: [Contact], matching query: String) -> [Contact] {\n        let needle = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)\n        guard !needle.isEmpty else { return contacts }\n\n        return contacts.filter { contact in\n            if contact.fullName.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle) { return true }\n            if contact.company.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle) { return true }\n            if contact.jobTitle.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle) { return true }\n            if contact.notes.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle) { return true }\n            return contact.fields.contains { $0.value.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle) }\n        }\n    }"

1	//
2	//  SpotlightIndexer.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  Pushes contacts into Spotlight's index. An actor so back-to-back calls
6	//  during a burst of mutations serialize cleanly — a delete-then-index
7	//  pair must not interleave with another pair or Spotlight ends up
8	//  reflecting an older snapshot (or empty).
9	//
10	//  Each call fetches a fresh snapshot via `ContactEntityQuery` instead of
11	//  trusting a caller-supplied list, because `@Query`'s post-save refresh
12	//  is asynchronous and can lag a `ContactStore.mutate` notification.
13	//
14	
15	import CoreSpotlight
16	import Foundation
17	
18	actor SpotlightIndexer {
19	    static let shared = SpotlightIndexer()
20	
21	    /// Identifier scope so we can clear *our* items without touching
22	    /// anything else Spotlight has indexed for this app.
23	    static let domainIdentifier = "com.scottdensmore.ContactManager.contacts"
24	
25	    /// Replaces our entire indexed set with a freshly-fetched snapshot.
26	    /// Errors are logged but not surfaced — a Spotlight indexing failure
27	    /// is a quality-of-life regression, not a user-visible error.
28	    func reindex() async {
29	        let entities = await (try? ContactEntityQuery().allEntities()) ?? []
30	        let index = CSSearchableIndex.default()
31	        let items = entities.map { entity in
32	            CSSearchableItem(
33	                uniqueIdentifier: entity.id,
34	                domainIdentifier: Self.domainIdentifier,
35	                attributeSet: entity.attributeSet
36	            )
37	        }
38	        do {
39	            try await index.deleteSearchableItems(withDomainIdentifiers: [Self.domainIdentifier])
40	            if !items.isEmpty {
41	                try await index.indexSearchableItems(items)
42	            }
43	        } catch {
44	            print("Spotlight reindex failed: \(error)")
45	        }
46	    }
47	}
48

1	//
2	//  ContactStore.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  The data layer for the contact manager: every create/edit/delete,
6	//  group, and vCard operation goes through here so the views stay thin and
7	//  the logic is unit-testable against an in-memory ModelContext.
8	//
9	//  Each mutating operation runs inside an explicit undo group, saves, and
10	//  rolls back on failure. The group's action name shows up in the Edit menu
11	//  (e.g. "Undo Create Contact") when the context has an UndoManager attached.
12	//
13	
14	import Foundation
15	import SwiftData
16	
17	@MainActor
18	struct ContactStore {
19	    let context: ModelContext
20	
21	    init(_ context: ModelContext) {
22	        self.context = context
23	    }
24	
25	    // MARK: - Contacts
26	
27	    /// Creates an empty contact, optionally adding it to a group.
28	    @discardableResult
29	    func createContact(in group: ContactGroup? = nil) throws -> Contact {
30	        try mutate("Create Contact") {
31	            let contact = Contact()
32	            if let group { contact.groups = [group] }
33	            context.insert(contact)
34	            return contact
35	        }
36	    }
37	
38	    func delete(_ contact: Contact) throws {
39	        try mutate("Delete Contact") {
40	            context.delete(contact)
41	        }
42	    }
43	
44	    func setPhotoData(_ data: Data?, on contact: Contact) throws {
45	        try mutate("Change Photo") {
46	            contact.photoData = data
47	        }
48	    }
49	
50	    // MARK: - Fields (emails / phones)
51	
52	    /// Adds a labeled field, keeping `sortIndex` strictly increasing so order
53	    /// is stable even after deletions.
54	    @discardableResult
55	    func addField(_ kind: FieldKind, value: String = "", to contact: Contact) throws -> ContactField {
56	        try mutate(kind == .email ? "Add Email" : "Add Phone") {
57	            let nextIndex = (contact.fields(of: kind).map(\.sortIndex).max() ?? -1) + 1
58	            let field = ContactField(kind: kind, label: kind.defaultLabel, value: value, sortIndex: nextIndex)
59	            field.contact = contact
60	            context.insert(field)
61	            return field
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    func delete(_ fields: [ContactField]) throws {
66	        try mutate("Delete Field") {
67	            fields.forEach(context.delete)
68	        }
69	    }
70	
71	    // MARK: - Groups
72	
73	    @discardableResult
74	    func createGroup(named name: String = "New Group") throws -> ContactGroup {
75	        try mutate("New Group") {
76	            let group = ContactGroup(name: name)
77	            context.insert(group)
78	            return group
79	        }
80	    }
81	
82	    /// Renames a group, ignoring blank names.
83	    func rename(_ group: ContactGroup, to name: String) throws {
84	        let trimmed = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
85	        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
86	        try mutate("Rename Group") {
87	            group.name = trimmed
88	        }
89	    }
90	
91	    func delete(_ group: ContactGroup) throws {
92	        try mutate("Delete Group") {
93	            context.delete(group)
94	        }
95	    }
96	
97	    func setMembership(of contact: Contact, in group: ContactGroup, isMember: Bool) throws {
98	        let alreadyMember = contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }
99	        guard isMember != alreadyMember else { return } // no-op; avoid an unnecessary save
100	
101	        try mutate("Change Group Membership") {
102	            if isMember {
103	                contact.groups.append(group)
104	            } else {
105	                contact.groups.removeAll { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }
106	            }
107	        }
108	    }
109	
110	    // MARK: - Merge duplicates
111	
112	    /// Merges several contacts into one canonical contact (the earliest
113	    /// created), then deletes the rest. Empty fields on the canonical contact
114	    /// are filled from the others, emails/phones are unioned and de-duplicated,
115	    /// group memberships are unioned, and a missing photo is adopted.
116	    @discardableResult
117	    func merge(_ contacts: [Contact]) throws -> Contact {
118	        // Earliest created wins, with a stable tiebreaker so the choice is
119	        // deterministic even when timestamps are identical.
120	        let ordered = contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in
121	            if lhs.createdAt != rhs.createdAt { return lhs.createdAt < rhs.createdAt }
122	            return String(describing: lhs.persistentModelID) < String(describing: rhs.persistentModelID)
123	        }
124	        guard let primary = ordered.first else {
125	            throw ContactStoreError.nothingToMerge
126	        }
127	        let others = ordered.dropFirst()
128	        guard !others.isEmpty else { return primary }
129	
130	        return try mutate("Merge Contacts") {
131	            for other in others {
132	                fillEmptyFields(of: primary, from: other)
133	                adoptGroups(into: primary, from: other)
134	            }
135	            mergeFields(into: primary, from: Array(others))
136	            others.forEach(context.delete)
137	            return primary
138	        }
139	    }
140	
141	    private func fillEmptyFields(of primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {
142	        /// Treat whitespace-only values as empty, consistent with the rest of
143	        /// the codebase (Contact.fullName, primaryEmail, etc.).
144	        func isBlank(_ value: String) -> Bool {
145	            value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
146	        }
147	        if isBlank(primary.firstName) { primary.firstName = other.firstName }
148	        if isBlank(primary.lastName) { primary.lastName = other.lastName }
149	        if isBlank(primary.company) { primary.company = other.company }
150	        if isBlank(primary.jobTitle) { primary.jobTitle = other.jobTitle }
151	        if isBlank(primary.street) { primary.street = other.street }
152	        if isBlank(primary.city) { primary.city = other.city }
153	        if isBlank(primary.state) { primary.state = other.state }
154	        if isBlank(primary.postalCode) { primary.postalCode = other.postalCode }
155	        if isBlank(primary.country) { primary.country = other.country }
156	        if isBlank(primary.notes) { primary.notes = other.notes }
157	        if primary.birthday == nil { primary.birthday = other.birthday }
158	        if primary.photoData == nil { primary.photoData = other.photoData }
159	    }
160	
161	    private func adoptGroups(into primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {
162	        let existing = Set(primary.groups.map(\.persistentModelID))
163	        for group in other.groups where !existing.contains(group.persistentModelID) {
164	            primary.groups.append(group)
165	        }
166	    }
167	
168	    /// Reassigns every contact's email/phone fields to `primary`, dropping
169	    /// blanks and value-duplicates and reindexing for a stable order.
170	    private func mergeFields(into primary: Contact, from others: [Contact]) {
171	        for kind in FieldKind.allCases {
172	            let candidates = primary.fields(of: kind) + others.flatMap { $0.fields(of: kind) }
173	            var seenValues: Set<String> = []
174	            var keptIndex = 0
175	            for field in candidates {
176	                let normalized = normalizedValue(of: field)
177	                if normalized.isEmpty || seenValues.contains(normalized) {
178	                    context.delete(field)
179	                    continue
180	                }
181	                seenValues.insert(normalized)
182	                field.contact = primary
183	                field.sortIndex = keptIndex
184	                keptIndex += 1
185	            }
186	        }
187	    }
188	
189	    private func normalizedValue(of field: ContactField) -> String {
190	        switch field.kind {
191	        case .email:
192	            field.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
193	        case .phone:
194	            String(field.value.filter(\.isNumber))
195	        }
196	    }
197	
198	    // MARK: - vCard import / export
199	
200	    /// Parses a vCard document and inserts the contacts it describes.
201	    @discardableResult
202	    func importVCards(from text: String) throws -> [Contact] {
203	        try importContacts(VCard.parse(text))
204	    }
205	
206	    /// Inserts contacts built from already-parsed vCards. (Parsing can be done
207	    /// off the main actor by the caller; insertion happens here.)
208	    @discardableResult
209	    func importContacts(_ parsed: [ParsedContact]) throws -> [Contact] {
210	        try mutate("Import Contacts") {
211	            let contacts = parsed.map(Self.makeContact(from:))
212	            contacts.forEach(context.insert)
213	            return contacts
214	        }
215	    }
216	
217	    /// Serializes contacts to a vCard document, sorted for stable output.
218	    func exportVCards(_ contacts: [Contact]) -> String {
219	        VCard.makeDocument(from: ContactQuery.sorted(contacts))
220	    }
221	
222	    /// Maps a parsed vCard into a new (uninserted) `Contact` with its fields.
223	    static func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {
224	        let contact = Contact(
225	            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,
226	            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,
227	            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,
228	            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,
229	            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes
230	        )
231	        // Normalize an imported photo through the avatar pipeline so storage
232	        // stays consistent (downscaled JPEG); an undecodable photo is dropped.
233	        if let raw = parsed.photoData {
234	            contact.photoData = ImageProcessing.avatarData(from: raw)
235	        }
236	        let emails = parsed.emails.enumerated().map { index, email in
237	            ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index)
238	        }
239	        let phones = parsed.phones.enumerated().map { index, phone in
240	            ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index)
241	        }
242	        contact.fields = emails + phones
243	        return contact
244	    }
245	
246	    // MARK: - Saving + undo
247	
248	    /// Wraps `body` in an explicit undo group, saves the context, and rolls
249	    /// back on failure. The group is given `actionName` so the Edit menu shows
250	    /// e.g. "Undo Create Contact".
251	    @discardableResult
252	    private func mutate<Result>(_ actionName: String, _ body: () throws -> Result) throws -> Result {
253	        let undoManager = context.undoManager
254	        undoManager?.beginUndoGrouping()
255	        do {
256	            let result = try body()
257	            try context.save()
258	            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()
259	            undoManager?.setActionName(actionName)
260	            // Observed by ContentView to refresh the Spotlight index. Fired
261	            // after the save commits so observers see the post-mutation state.
262	            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .contactsDidChange, object: nil)
263	            return result
264	        } catch {
265	            context.rollback()
266	            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()
267	            throw error
268	        }
269	    }
270	}
271	
272	enum ContactStoreError: LocalizedError {
273	    case nothingToMerge
274	
275	    var errorDescription: String? {
276	        switch self {
277	        case .nothingToMerge: "There were no contacts to merge."
278	        }
279	    }
280	}
281

name: contactmanager-modernization
description: Direction and PR roadmap for modernizing the ContactManager macOS app
metadata: 
  node_type: memory

The ContactManager app (an old ObjC/AppKit + Core Data + XIB demo) is being rebuilt into a **native macOS Tahoe (macOS 26) app**. Decisions confirmed by the user on 2026-05-25:

- **Full SwiftUI rewrite** (NavigationSplitView: sidebar / list / detail, Liquid Glass).
- **SwiftData** as the persistence layer (replacing Core Data).
- Wants **all four feature areas**: search & alphabetical sections, contact photos (initials fallback), richer fields (multiple emails/phones, company/title, address, birthday, notes), groups/tags + vCard import/export.

**Why:** User wants the app to keep evolving toward a polished native Tahoe contact manager; it doubles as a best-practices demo.

**How to apply:** Ship as focused, single-purpose PRs (matching the existing PR #1–#8 workflow), each building cleanly. Roadmap + status:
- PR A — Foundation ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #9. SwiftUI+SwiftData shell, CRUD, seed data, macOS 26, ObjC/XIB removed, Swift Testing.
- PR B — Richer fields ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #11 (originally #10; see lesson below). ContactField child entity (labeled emails/phones), company/title/address/birthday/notes, grouped Form editor.
- PR C — Search & sections ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #12. Live search, alphabetical sections + "#", Last/First name sort toggle (@AppStorage).
- PR D — Contact photos ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #13. External-storage photoData, photo well in detail, ImageProcessing downscaling, off-main processing.
- PR E — Groups & vCard ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #14. ContactGroup many-to-many, sidebar group CRUD, detail membership toggles, pure vCard 3.0 reader/writer + File import/export.
- PR F — Tahoe Liquid Glass polish ✅ MERGED — GitHub PR #15. Glass-prominent action buttons, list/selection/avatar animations, min window size.

Tooling/conventions: PR #16 (`chore/lint-format-and-conventions`) adds SwiftLint + SwiftFormat (configs `.swiftlint.yml`/`.swiftformat`), a Makefile, a SwiftLint build phase, and a root `CLAUDE.md`. Run `make check` (format-check + lint + test) before opening PRs; conventions live in CLAUDE.md (loaded each session). SwiftFormat owns comma/brace style; SwiftLint's trailing_comma is disabled and wrapMultilineStatementBraces is disabled to keep the two consistent + idempotent.

ROADMAP COMPLETE as of 2026-05-26: all six PRs (#9, #11, #12, #13, #14, #15) merged to main. App is a native SwiftUI + SwiftData macOS 26 contact manager; 21 Swift Testing tests across 3 suites green on main. Future work would be net-new (e.g., CloudKit sync, contact dedup, vCard PHOTO round-trip, AppKit→SwiftUI inspector).

Liquid Glass note (macOS 26.5 SDK): `.glassEffect()` modifier and `GlassEffectContainer` are NOT in the SwiftUI swiftinterface, but `.buttonStyle(.glass)` / `.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)` (GlassButtonStyle/GlassProminentButtonStyle) and `.backgroundExtensionEffect()` ARE. Toolbars + NavigationSplitView adopt Liquid Glass automatically when built against the SDK.

As of 2026-05-25, #9 and #11 are MERGED into main; 9 Swift tests green on main.

Copilot review fixes already applied (don't regress): error-state container load with "Reset Data" (no fatalError), save-error alerts + rollback in ContentView, throwing SampleData.seedIfNeeded, deterministic avatar color from createdAt (not hashValue/abs), ContactField sortIndex = max+1.

Key learnings:
- Toolchain: Xcode 26.5, macOS 26.5 SDK, Swift 6.3 (SWIFT_VERSION 5.0 in project). Project `.pbxproj` restructured via the Ruby `xcodeproj` gem (available), not hand-edited. App icon from PR #7 preserved.
- SwiftData tests: use `@Suite(.serialized)` + `@MainActor`, hold the `ModelContainer` as a stored property, and have the host app skip building its own container while testing (`XCTestConfigurationFilePath` env) — concurrent/duplicate containers for the same `@Model` trap SwiftData.
- SwiftData migration: new non-optional scalar attributes MUST have inline defaults (e.g. `var city: String = ""`) or in-place migration fails with NSCocoaError 134110.
- No display access in this environment — cannot screencapture the running app; verify via build + tests + headless launch (process stays alive).
- `gh pr merge --delete-branch` deletes the LOCAL branch too, and deleting a base branch of a stacked PR CLOSES the dependent PR (GitHub won't retarget, and a closed PR whose base is gone can't be reopened/retargeted). For stacked PRs: merge the base PR, then retarget the child PR to main BEFORE deleting the base branch — or just recreate the child PR from its branch (that's what happened: #10 closed → recreated as #11).

5	//  The App Intents identity for a `Contact`. Conforms to `IndexedEntity`

14	struct ContactEntity: AppEntity, IndexedEntity {
15	    static let typeDisplayRepresentation = TypeDisplayRepresentation(name: "Contact")
16	    static let defaultQuery = ContactEntityQuery()
17	
18	    /// Stable identifier: the contact's `PersistentIdentifier` encoded as
19	    /// a string (same scheme used by the default-group preference).
20	    var id: String
21	    var displayName: String
22	    var company: String
23	    var jobTitle: String
24	    var emails: [String]
25	    var phones: [String]

29	            title: "\(displayName)",
30	            subtitle: subtitleText.map { "\($0)" }
31	        )
32	    }
33	
34	    /// CoreSpotlight metadata built from the same fields the entity carries,
35	    /// so Spotlight's preview shows the same info Shortcuts/Siri reads.
36	    var attributeSet: CSSearchableItemAttributeSet {
37	        let attrs = CSSearchableItemAttributeSet(contentType: .contact)
38	        attrs.displayName = displayName
39	        attrs.contentDescription = subtitleText
40	        if !emails.isEmpty { attrs.emailAddresses = emails }
41	        if !phones.isEmpty { attrs.phoneNumbers = phones }
42	        if !company.isBlank { attrs.organizations = [company] }
43	        if !jobTitle.isBlank { attrs.title = jobTitle }
44	        return attrs
45	    }
46	
47	    /// Subtitle preferences match the contact list row: primary email, then
48	    /// primary phone, then company. Whitespace-only values are treated as
49	    /// empty (same as `Contact.subtitle`) so Shortcuts/Spotlight never show
50	    /// a blank-looking subtitle.
51	    private var subtitleText: String? {
52	        if let first = emails.first(where: { !$0.isBlank }) { return first }
53	        if let first = phones.first(where: { !$0.isBlank }) { return first }
54	        if !company.isBlank { return company }
55	        return nil
56	    }
57	}

59	extension ContactEntity {

61	    /// off the main actor as long as the `Contact` is fetched there too.

1	//
2	//  ContactEntityQuery.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  Lookup paths for `ContactEntity`: by id (Shortcuts handoff + Spotlight
6	//  open), by free-text string (Find Contact intent), and "all" (Spotlight
7	//  re-index and the Shortcuts picker).
8	//
9	
10	import AppIntents
11	import Foundation
12	import SwiftData
13	
14	struct ContactEntityQuery: EntityQuery, EnumerableEntityQuery, EntityStringQuery {
15	    func entities(for identifiers: [ContactEntity.ID]) async throws -> [ContactEntity] {
16	        guard let container = EntityModelContainer.shared else { return [] }
17	        let wanted = Set(identifiers)
18	        return try await Self.snapshot(container: container) { contacts in
19	            contacts.filter { wanted.contains($0.persistentModelID.storedString ?? "") }
20	        }
21	    }
22	
23	    func entities(matching string: String) async throws -> [ContactEntity] {
24	        guard let container = EntityModelContainer.shared else { return [] }
25	        let needle = string.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
26	        guard !needle.isEmpty else { return [] }
27	        return try await Self.snapshot(container: container) { contacts in
28	            // Reuse the same matcher the contact list uses so Shortcuts and
29	            // in-app search behave the same.
30	            ContactQuery.filtered(contacts, matching: needle)
31	        }
32	    }
33	
34	    func suggestedEntities() async throws -> [ContactEntity] {
35	        try await allEntities()
36	    }
37	
38	    func allEntities() async throws -> [ContactEntity] {
39	        guard let container = EntityModelContainer.shared else { return [] }
40	        return try await Self.snapshot(container: container) { $0 }
41	    }
42	
43	    /// Fetches every contact on a fresh background context, applies the
44	    /// caller's filter, and maps to entity values. The fetch and the
45	    /// mapping both happen on the same actor as the context (none here),
46	    /// so the resulting `[ContactEntity]` is safe to send to App Intents
47	    /// callers on any actor.
48	    private static func snapshot(
49	        container: ModelContainer,
50	        filter: (_ contacts: [Contact]) -> [Contact]
51	    ) async throws -> [ContactEntity] {
52	        let context = ModelContext(container)
53	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<Contact>(
54	            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.lastName), SortDescriptor(\.firstName)]
55	        )
56	        let contacts = try context.fetch(descriptor)
57	        return filter(contacts).map(ContactEntity.init(contact:))
58	    }
59	}

1	//
2	//  EntityModelContainer.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  A process-wide handle to the app's `ModelContainer`. App Intents and
6	//  CoreSpotlight queries need to read contacts without going through the
7	//  SwiftUI environment; the app sets this once after `loadContainer()`
8	//  succeeds and the entity query reads it from any actor.
9	//
10	//  Access is guarded by an `OSAllocatedUnfairLock` so concurrent reads
11	//  during a launch-time setup are well-defined. The lock is held only
12	//  long enough to read or write the container reference itself.
13	//
14	
15	import Foundation
16	import os
17	import SwiftData
18	
19	enum EntityModelContainer {
20	    private static let storage = OSAllocatedUnfairLock<ModelContainer?>(initialState: nil)
21	
22	    /// The shared container, populated by `ContactManagerApp` after the
23	    /// store loads. `nil` if loading failed or we're running under tests.
24	    static var shared: ModelContainer? {
25	        get { storage.withLock { $0 } }
26	        set { storage.withLock { $0 = newValue } }
27	    }
28	}
29

1	//
2	//  PersistentIdentifierEncoding.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  `PersistentIdentifier` is `Codable` but not directly storable in
6	//  `@AppStorage` (which only takes a handful of property-list types).
7	//  These helpers round-trip a PID through a JSON string so a preference
8	//  can point at a SwiftData model without depending on a mutable display
9	//  name.
10	//
11	
12	import Foundation
13	import SwiftData
14	
15	extension PersistentIdentifier {
16	    /// JSON-encoded string suitable for `@AppStorage`. Returns `nil` only
17	    /// if encoding unexpectedly fails (shouldn't in practice).
18	    var storedString: String? {
19	        guard let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(self) else { return nil }
20	        return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)
21	    }
22	
23	    /// Inverse of `storedString`. Returns `nil` for the empty string (the
24	    /// "no value" sentinel) or any string that isn't a valid encoded PID.
25	    static func decode(stored string: String) -> PersistentIdentifier? {
26	        guard !string.isEmpty,
27	              let data = string.data(using: .utf8),
28	              let id = try? JSONDecoder().decode(PersistentIdentifier.self, from: data)
29	        else { return nil }
30	        return id
31	    }
32	}

Fired\n            // after the save commits so observers see the post-mutation state.\n            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .contactsDidChange, object: nil)\n            return result\n        } catch {\n            context.rollback()\n            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()\n            throw error\n        }\n    }\n}",

The group is given `actionName` so the Edit menu shows\n    /// e.g. \"Undo Create Contact\".\n    @discardableResult\n    private func mutate<Result>(_ actionName: String, _ body: () throws -> Result) throws -> Result {\n        let undoManager = context.undoManager\n        undoManager?.beginUndoGrouping()\n        do {\n            let result = try body()\n\n            // Snapshot the context's pending changes *before* the save clears\n            // them, so the notification can carry a precise delta and the\n            // Spotlight index updates incrementally rather than rebuilding the\n            // whole thing on every edit.\n            let touched = context.insertedModelsArray + context.changedModelsArray\n            let deletedModels = context.deletedModelsArray\n            // Deleted contacts already hold permanent ids (they were saved\n            // before), so read them now — after the save the objects are gone.\n            let deletedIDs = Set(\n                deletedModels.compactMap { ($0 as? Contact)?.persistentModelID.storedString }\n            )\n            // A field can be deleted while its owning contact survives (Delete\n            // Field, or merge folding duplicates). Capture those owners now,\n            // while the inverse relationship is still intact, so the contact's\n            // emails/phones get refreshed.\n            let survivingFieldOwnerIDs = Set(\n                deletedModels.compactMap { ($0 as? ContactField)?.contact?.persistentModelID.storedString }\n            )\n\n            try context.save()\n            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()\n            undoManager?.setActionName(actionName)\n\n            // Read updated ids *after* the save: a freshly inserted contact's\n            // pre-save id is temporary and wouldn't match a later fetch-by-id;\n            // the save promotes it to the permanent identifier in place.\n            var updatedIDs = Set(touched.compactMap(Self.affectedContactID))\n            updatedIDs.formUnion(survivingFieldOwnerIDs)\n            updatedIDs.subtract(deletedIDs) // never re-index a contact we just deleted\n            let change = ContactChange(updatedIDs: updatedIDs, deletedIDs: deletedIDs)\n\n            // Observed by ContentView to refresh the Spotlight index. Fired\n            // after the save commits so observers see the post-mutation state,\n            // and carries the delta so the refresh stays incremental.\n            NotificationCenter.default.post(\n                name: .contactsDidChange,\n                object: nil,\n                userInfo: [ContactChange.userInfoKey: change]\n            )\n            return result\n        } catch {\n            context.rollback()\n            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()\n            throw error\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Maps a touched model to the contact whose Spotlight entry it affects: a\n    /// `Contact` directly, or a `ContactField` via its owner. Other models\n    /// (e.g. `ContactGroup`) don't appear in the index and map to `nil`.\n    private static func affectedContactID(of model: any PersistentModel) -> String? {\n        switch model {\n        case let contact as Contact:\n            contact.persistentModelID.storedString\n        case let field as ContactField:\n            field.contact?.persistentModelID.storedString\n        default:\n            nil\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The set of contacts a `ContactStore` mutation touched, delivered in the\n/// `.contactsDidChange` notification so observers (the Spotlight indexer) can\n/// update incrementally. Ids are encoded `PersistentIdentifier`s — the same\n/// scheme `ContactEntity.id` uses, so they round-trip through a fetch-by-id.\nstruct ContactChange: Sendable {\n    /// Contacts created or edited — their Spotlight entry needs refreshing.\n    var updatedIDs: Set<String>\n    /// Contacts deleted — their Spotlight entry must be removed.\n    var deletedIDs: Set<String>\n\n    /// True when the mutation touched no indexable contact (e.g. renaming a\n    /// group), letting observers skip work entirely.\n    var isEmpty: Bool { updatedIDs.isEmpty && deletedIDs.isEmpty }\n\n    /// `userInfo` key the change rides under in `.contactsDidChange`.\n    static let userInfoKey = \"ContactManager.contactChange\"\n}"
}

ContactEntityQuery().allEntities()) ?? []\n        let index = CSSearchableIndex.default()\n        let items = entities.map { entity in\n            CSSearchableItem(\n                uniqueIdentifier: entity.id,\n                domainIdentifier: Self.domainIdentifier,\n                attributeSet: entity.attributeSet\n            )\n        }\n        do {\n            try await index.deleteSearchableItems(withDomainIdentifiers: [Self.domainIdentifier])\n            if !items.isEmpty {\n                try await index.indexSearchableItems(items)\n            }\n        } catch {\n            print(\"Spotlight reindex failed: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "    /// Replaces our entire indexed set with a freshly-fetched snapshot.\n    /// Used at launch and as a fallback; per-mutation refreshes should go\n    /// through `apply(_:)` so they don't rebuild the whole index.\n    /// Errors are logged but not surfaced — a Spotlight indexing failure\n    /// is a quality-of-life regression, not a user-visible error.\n    func reindex() async {\n        let entities = await (try? ContactEntityQuery().allEntities()) ?? []\n        let index = CSSearchableIndex.default()\n        let items = entities.map(Self.makeItem)\n        do {\n            try await index.deleteSearchableItems(withDomainIdentifiers: [Self.domainIdentifier])\n            if !items.isEmpty {\n                try await index.indexSearchableItems(items)\n            }\n        } catch {\n            print(\"Spotlight reindex failed: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Applies a single mutation's delta: re-indexes the updated contacts\n    /// (fetched fresh by id) and removes the deleted ones. O(changed) instead\n    /// of `reindex()`'s O(all contacts), so a one-contact edit no longer\n    /// rebuilds the entire index. Like `reindex()`, errors are logged only.\n    func apply(_ change: ContactChange) async {\n        guard !change.isEmpty else { return }\n        let index = CSSearchableIndex.default()\n        do {\n            if !change.deletedIDs.isEmpty {\n                try await index.deleteSearchableItems(withIdentifiers: Array(change.deletedIDs))\n            }\n            if !change.updatedIDs.isEmpty {\n                // Fetch only the touched contacts. An id with no match (created\n                // and removed before we got here) simply yields no item.\n                let entities = await (try? ContactEntityQuery().entities(for: Array(change.updatedIDs))) ?? []\n                let items = entities.map(Self.makeItem)\n                if !items.isEmpty {\n                    try await index.indexSearchableItems(items)\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            print(\"Spotlight incremental update failed: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func makeItem(for entity: ContactEntity) -> CSSearchableItem {\n        CSSearchableItem(\n            uniqueIdentifier: entity.id,\n            domainIdentifier: domainIdentifier,\n            attributeSet: entity.attributeSet\n        )\n    }\n}"
}

ContactChange\n        }\n        defer { NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(token) }\n        try body()\n        return captured\n    }\n\n    @Test func createEmitsUpdateForTheNewContact() store.createContact()\n        let id = try #require(contact.persistentModelID.storedString)\n\n        let change = try #require(try change { try store.addField(.email, to: contact) })\n        #expect(change.updatedIDs.contains(id))\n        #expect(change.deletedIDs.isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func deleteFieldEmitsUpdateForSurvivingOwner() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        let field = try store.addField(.phone, value: \"555\", to: contact)\n        let id = try #require(contact.persistentModelID.storedString)\n\n        let change = try #require(try change { try store.delete([field]) })\n        #expect(change.updatedIDs == [id]) // owner refreshed, not deleted\n        #expect(change.deletedIDs.isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func > AGENT

Found the real bug — and it's a meaningful one. The failure shows the **same** contact (`p1`, identical URI) encoding to two **different** strings because `storedString` uses `JSONEncoder` without sorted keys, so key order is non-deterministic *within a single process*.

This isn't just a test problem: my incremental `apply(_:)` matches contacts by `storedString` equality in `ContactEntityQuery.entities(for:)` (`wanted.contains($0.persistentModelID.storedString)`). If the id encoded at save-time differs in key order from the id encoded at fetch-time, the lookup misses and the contact silently never gets indexed. The pre-existing Spotlight-open path has the same latent fragility. The fix is to make `storedString` canonical:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_019es2oBbWdhFydvgyfC2Yze
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/contactmanager/ContactManager/Support/PersistentIdentifierEncoding.swift",
  "old_string": "    /// JSON-encoded string suitable for `@AppStorage`. Returns `nil` only\n    /// if encoding unexpectedly fails (shouldn't in practice).\n    var storedString: String? {\n        guard let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(self) else { return nil }\n        return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)\n    }",
  "new_string": "    /// JSON-encoded string suitable for `@AppStorage`. Returns `nil` only\n    /// if encoding unexpectedly fails (shouldn't in practice).\n    ///\n    /// Keys are sorted so the *same* identifier always encodes to the *same*\n    /// string. Without this, `PersistentIdentifier`'s Codable output reorders\n    /// keys between encodings (even within one process), and any code that\n    /// compares two separately-encoded ids by string — Spotlight's\n    /// `entities(for:)` lookup, incremental re-index matching — would miss.\n    var storedString: String? {\n        let encoder = JSONEncoder()\n        encoder.outputFormatting = .sortedKeys\n        guard let data = try? encoder.encode(self) else { return nil }\n        return String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)\n    }"
}
```

  "old_string": "    @Test func entityIdMatchesEncodedPersistentIdentifier() throws {\n        // The id is reused by `selectContact(byEncodedID:)` and the\n        // default-group preference — they must agree on the encoding.\n        let contact = sampleContact()\n        let entity = ContactEntity(contact: contact)\n        let decoded = try #require(PersistentIdentifier.decode(stored: entity.id))\n        #expect(decoded == contact.persistentModelID)\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "    @Test func entityIdMatchesEncodedPersistentIdentifier() throws {\n        // The id is reused by `selectContact(byEncodedID:)` and the\n        // default-group preference — they must agree on the encoding.\n        let contact = sampleContact()\n        let entity = ContactEntity(contact: contact)\n        let decoded = try #require(PersistentIdentifier.decode(stored: entity.id))\n        #expect(decoded == contact.persistentModelID)\n    }\n\n    @Test func encodedIdIsStableAcrossEncodings() {\n        // Spotlight's incremental re-index and `entities(for:)` lookup match\n        // contacts by comparing two separately-encoded ids as strings, so the\n        // same identifier must always encode to the same string.\n        let id = sampleContact().persistentModelID\n        #expect(id.storedString == id.storedString)\n    }\n}"
}

Group-only changes (e.g. rename) map to no\ncontact and are a no-op.\n\nAlso makes `PersistentIdentifier.storedString` deterministic\n(`.sortedKeys`). Its Codable output otherwise reorders keys between\nencodings — even within one process — so the id captured at save time\ncould differ as a string from the same id re-encoded at fetch time,\nmaking the by-id lookup (and the pre-existing Spotlight-open path) miss.\nSurfaced by a flaky equality assertion in the new tests.\n\nTests: new SpotlightDeltaTests suite asserts the emitted delta for\ncreate / delete / add-field / delete-field / group-rename / merge;\nContactEntityTests gains an id-encoding stability check. 101 unit tests\n+ 3 UI tests green.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>\nEOF\n)\"",

Every `ContactStore` mutation posted a payload-less `.contactsDidChange`, and `ContentView` answered it by rebuilding the **entire** Spotlight index — delete-the-whole-domain + re-index every contact. That's O(all contacts) per single edit, with a brief window where the index is empty.\n\n- **Per-mutation delta.** `mutate` now snapshots the context's pending changes around the save and broadcasts a `ContactChange { updatedIDs, deletedIDs }`:\n  - `updatedIDs` = inserted/changed `Contact`s, plus the owning contact of any inserted/changed/deleted `ContactField` (a contact's emails/phones feed its Spotlight entry), minus anything being deleted.\n  - `deletedIDs` = removed `Contact`s.\n  - Ids are read **after** the save so a freshly inserted contact carries its permanent `PersistentIdentifier` (the temporary pre-save id wouldn't match a later fetch). Owners of deleted fields are captured **before** the save, while the inverse relationship is still intact.\n- **Incremental apply.** `SpotlightIndexer.apply(_:)` deletes the removed ids, fetches only the updated contacts by id, and re-indexes those — O(changed) instead of O(all). `reindex()` stays for launch and as a fallback when a post arrives without a payload. Group-only changes (e.g. rename) map to no contact and are a no-op.\n- **Determinism fix (latent bug).** `PersistentIdentifier.storedString` now encodes with `.sortedKeys`. Its `Codable` output otherwise reorders keys between encodings — even within one process — so the id captured at save time could differ *as a string* from the same id re-encoded at fetch time, making the by-id lookup (and the pre-existing Spotlight-**open** path in `entities(for:)`) silently miss. A flaky equality assertion in the new tests surfaced it.\n\n## Test plan\n- [x] `make check` — 101 unit tests + 3 UI tests pass; ran the unit suite 3× to confirm the determinism fix removed the flake\n- [x] New `SpotlightDeltaTests` suite asserts the emitted delta for create / delete / add-field / delete-field / group-rename / merge\n- [x] `ContactEntityTests` gains an id-encoding stability check\n- [ ] Manual: edit a single contact in a large store and confirm its Spotlight entry updates without the whole index churning; delete a contact and confirm it drops out of Spotlight\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\nEOF\n)\"",
  "description": "Open PR"
}

> AGENT

This pinpoints the real impact. The good news: `pruneStaleDefaultGroup()` and the create-contact path compare via **decoded `PersistentIdentifier`** (order-independent), so the preference still *functions* after the format change — only the Settings Picker's string-tag highlight could go blank for a value written by an older build. And since the old encoder was already non-deterministic, that Picker match was already fragile across launches; `.sortedKeys` fixes it permanently.

I'll fully neutralize Copilot's concern by normalizing the stored value to canonical form in the prune pass (self-healing migration), and fix the test to unwrap. Two edits:

> TOOL

```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/contactmanager/ContactManager/Views/SettingsView.swift",
  "old_string": "    private func pruneStaleDefaultGroup() {\n        guard !defaultGroupID.isEmpty,\n              let id = PersistentIdentifier.decode(stored: defaultGroupID)\n        else {\n            if !defaultGroupID.isEmpty { defaultGroupID = \"\" }\n            return\n        }\n        if !groups.contains(where: { $0.persistentModelID == id }) {\n            defaultGroupID = \"\"\n        }\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "    private func pruneStaleDefaultGroup() {\n        guard !defaultGroupID.isEmpty,\n              let id = PersistentIdentifier.decode(stored: defaultGroupID)\n        else {\n            if !defaultGroupID.isEmpty { defaultGroupID = \"\" }\n            return\n        }\n        guard groups.contains(where: { $0.persistentModelID == id }) else {\n            defaultGroupID = \"\"\n            return\n        }\n        // Re-store in the canonical (sorted-key) encoding. A value written by\n        // an older build used a non-deterministic key order, so its string\n        // wouldn't match the freshly-encoded picker tags; normalizing here\n        // keeps the selection highlighted without a separate migration.\n        if let canonical = id.storedString, canonical != defaultGroupID {\n            defaultGroupID = canonical\n        }\n    }\n}"
}

## Done — P0 #4: incremental Spotlight indexing

**What shipped:**
- `ContactStore.mutate` now snapshots the context's pending changes around the save and broadcasts a `ContactChange { updatedIDs, deletedIDs }`, mapping each touched model (incl. `ContactField` → owning contact) to the affected contact. Ids are read post-save so fresh inserts carry their permanent identifier.
- `SpotlightIndexer.apply(_:)` updates just the delta — delete removed ids, re-index only the changed contacts (O(changed) vs the old O(all) full-domain rebuild). `reindex()` stays for launch/fallback.
- **Latent bug fixed along the way:** `PersistentIdentifier.storedString` now encodes with `.sortedKeys`. Its Codable output reordered keys between encodings even within one process, so the CoreSpotlight unique id captured at save time could differ from the same id re-encoded at fetch/delete time — breaking by-id matching (and the pre-existing Spotlight-open path). Surfaced by a flaky test assertion.

**Review loop:** Copilot raised two points — both addressed in a follow-up commit and replied to in-thread:
1. Test could pass on `nil == nil` → now `#require`s both encodings.
2. Format change orphans existing `@AppStorage` values → `pruneStaleDefaultGroup()` now self-heals old-format ids to canonical form; the preference never functionally broke (consumers compare decoded identifiers, not strings).

**Verification:** 101 unit tests + 3 UI tests green (ran 3× to confirm the determinism flake is gone); `make check` clean; CI green on both commits.
